description.fun: Chimchar's tail-end flame runs on gas made in its belly, and not even rain can put it out, though Chimchar snuffs it before bed so it doesn't start a fire. That glowing rear once had people mistaking it for an apparition they called the 'Lantern-Tail'. A nimble climber, it lives high on craggy mountains. Takao Unno designed it and its evolutions.
description.guide: Chimchar is a small Fire-type chimpanzee and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Sinnoh. The flame on its rear is fuelled by gas from its belly and burns weakly when it is unwell. It evolves into Monferno and then Infernape.
description.tagline: A cheeky chimp with a fire burning on its rear.

description.fun: Monferno's tail fire is both weapon and status symbol: it stretches the flame to look bigger and to keep foes at just the right distance, and in a troop the biggest fire and the brightest blue face markings rank highest. It springs off walls and ceilings to strike from above, a style that seems to draw on Monkey Kung Fu and fits its new Fighting type.
description.guide: Monferno is the evolved form of Chimchar and gains the Fighting type. It controls the flame on its tail to keep opponents at a distance, and the brightness of its blue face markings shows its standing in its troop. It evolves into Infernape.
description.tagline: A fiery monkey whose face markings show its rank.

description.fun: Infernape fights in a style all its own, using all four limbs wreathed in flame, so a battle with it looks like a dance. The crown of fire on its head is said never to go out, not even while it sleeps. Its gold markings seem to nod to Sun Wukong, the Monkey King of Journey to the West, and perhaps to Hanuman, the fireproof monkey hero of the Ramayana.
description.guide: Infernape is the final form of Chimchar, a Fire- and Fighting-type primate with a flame burning on its head. It fights with fiery punches and kicks using all its limbs and is known for its speed. Its design draws on the Monkey King of Journey to the West.
description.tagline: A kung fu fire monkey with a crown of flame.
